scenarios.name: Reverse the available command list using its Name header

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible
the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands for an empty Part Tools custom panel
the available command list shows the separator and an unlabeled row above commands in ascending name order
the user clicks the available command list Name header
the separator remains at the top of the visible list
the visible command names begin in descending order with "Zoom Window", "Zoom Selected", "Zoom All", and "Zoom"
the user clicks the available command list Name header again
the visible command names begin in ascending order with "2-D Drawing", "2D Sketches", and "3D Annotations"
the custom panel list remains empty
